source.citation: Jefferies, M. G. (1993). Nor-Sand: a simple critical state model for sand. Geotechnique 43(1), 91–103.
source.access_limitation: Web access exposes a 13-page PDF and extracted text. Direct PDF download previously returned HTTP 403; no local byte snapshot. Screenshot requests returned no inspectable image, so equation images remain unverified.
source.review_scope: Targeted text review of assumptions, constitutive ingredients, calibration and comparison passages; equation-image verification remains open.

claims.statement: Original rigid-plastic, rate-independent, effective-stress, axisymmetric drained formulation; associated flow and coaxial increments.
Current state parameter links density and pressure; image pressure controls yield size and hardening.
claims.locator: pp. 92–93, Axiom 2 and Concept; p. 98, Fig. 8 discussion

claims.statement: Erksak example supplies critical-state information and N from dilatancy; h is adjusted to initial shear stiffness. Initial void ratio and pressure determine initial state.
claims.locator: p. 100, Comparison of Nor-Sand with experiment, D667 calibration paragraphs

claims.statement: Post-peak localization limits comparison with nominal whole-specimen strain.

paper_interpretation.implication: A source-case fitted count cannot substitute for a complete calibration-information budget.

remaining_review: Obtain an archivable primary-source copy and verify equation images before transcription.
Audit the complete material-input and initialization dependencies before assigning dimensions.
Resolve lineage without importing properties of later variants.
Complete formulation screening and independent scientific review.

material_input_candidates.qualification: Check log base, pressure units and intercept reference before transcription.

fixed_empirical_input.source_treatment: Universal coefficient representing an averaged fabric effect; not a separately fitted sand-specific constant in this variant.

initialization_dependencies.locator: Fig. 1, p. 93; Eqs. 7, 9–10, p. 96; Fig. 8 discussion, p. 98
initialization_dependencies.review_question: Resolve yield-consistent image pressure and overconsolidation; do not count image pressure as an independent input without checking constraints.
